lines.en: My nose horn forward, I tread the moss
My slender legs take small steps
A Jurassic hunter takes a stroll

lines.zh: 细尾抬高，替我压住步子
lines.en: Tail lifted high, it steadies my stride
I cross a damp English wood
The horn on my head sways as I walk
My claws tap lightly on the fallen leaves
I follow the line of roots around
Forty health is enough to walk far
I slip low through the grass
My two hind legs push steadily
I stop now and then to listen
My shadow cuts between the trunks
I test the ground with each step
The bones under my hide move steadily
I head for the clearing between the trees
My tracks stay in the wet clay
I shift to the leeward side and walk on
I stand with my nose horn into the wind
I watch the movement in the tree shadows
My breathing is shallow, my feet are still
My tail slowly draws an arc
I am working out whether to move
The air in this wood is a little sweet

lines.zh: 我把重心换到另一条腿
lines.en: I shift my weight to the other leg
I am listening very carefully

lines.zh: 侏罗纪的中立者不着急
lines.en: A neutral Jurassic one is in no hurry
I open my mouth a little to cool down
The shadow stops at my feet

lines.zh: 我像一株长错地方的树
lines.en: I look like a tree in the wrong place

lines.zh: 我把头偏成一个小角度
lines.en: I tilt my head to a small angle
I hear wings somewhere far off
I wait without moving
The moss is cool and pleasant underfoot
You have no scales, which is strange

lines.zh: 我闻到你手里的东西了
lines.en: I smell what you are holding
Your eyes keep following me
I will not strike first, but do not test me
Two-legged one, which way are you going
I tilt my head and measure you
You are that tall, so there should be plenty of meat
I step back half a step to let you pass
Let us leave each other alone, agreed

lines.zh: 你手里的东西让我犹豫
lines.en: What you hold makes me hesitate
Your shadow is longer than mine
I note where you are standing
The pain twists my head aside

lines.zh: 一道口子留在我的侧腹
lines.en: A gash is left on my flank
I am not used to being touched
I back half a step and hold
Blood wells up between my scales
I lower myself to shield the wound
That one made me angry

lines.zh: 腿在抖，可我还没倒下去
lines.en: My legs shake, but I am still upright
I shake my head to throw off the pain

lines.zh: 我盯着伤你的那个方向
lines.en: I stare toward whatever hurt me
That is meat, I would guess
You wave it and I almost want to follow
A carnivore's nose is not wrong
I lean half a step forward
Give it to me and I will let it go
This smells very fresh
I narrow my eyes and gauge the distance
You are too far, I cannot reach it
I keep my eyes on your hand
I am a little tempted
My mouth is starting to water

lines.zh: 我们之间还能再近一点
lines.en: We could still be a little closer
The smell of meat is very plain
I am not rushing, but I do not want to wait

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经摆起来了
lines.en: My tail has started to swing
Try putting the meat on the ground
My nose horn bumped your leg
You knocked me a step sideways
We bounce apart half a block
My tail lashed against you
You stepped on my toes

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，但我不喜欢
lines.en: That did not hurt, but I dislike it
I go around you and keep walking
Two living things collide
I growl once to show my displeasure
This gap suits us both
We walk side by side through the wood

lines.zh: 我的鼻角碰了碰你的鼻角
lines.en: My nose horn touches yours

lines.zh: 两只原角鼻龙绕成一圈
lines.en: Two proceratosaurs circle together

lines.zh: 你的尾巴搭在我的尾巴上
lines.en: Your tail rests over mine
We trade scents with low sounds

lines.zh: 同一片湿林，同一对脚印
lines.en: One damp wood, one pair of tracks
I yield the shade to you

lines.zh: 我们在苔地上并排低头
lines.en: We lower our heads together on the moss

lines.zh: 侏罗纪也有安静的时刻
lines.en: Even the Jurassic has quiet moments
We head deeper into the wood together
I pick up a piece of meat
What hides under the leaves is mine
I pin it with a foreclaw and bite
This still smells of blood
I push the bone fragments aside
I lower my head and take a small piece
Something on the ground is glinting
I drag it behind a tree

lines.zh: 这一点不够吃，但先收着
lines.en: Not enough to eat, but I will keep it
I swallow it slowly
The grass moves, but against the wind
I have fixed on that shadow
It has its back to me, perfect
I raise my nose horn at it

lines.zh: 四十点生命的力气用得上
lines.en: Forty health of strength is good for this
The prey is behind the roots
I have not made a sound in one step
It moved, so I moved
This is the old Jurassic rule
I have decided to act
I lower myself and circle around
It has not noticed my nose horn
I step where the leaves are thickest

lines.zh: 我数着它的步子，越数越近
lines.en: I count its steps; each count is closer
My breath is almost gone
The tree shadows hide my shape
It starts turning its head uneasily

lines.zh: 它再走两步就进我的扑程
lines.en: Two more of its steps and it is in my pounce
My hind legs are already tense
I wait for it to step into my range
I spring and bite its leg
My nose horn butts it first
My claws press down on its back
This bite lands on its shoulder
I shake my head and tear the hide
My charge knocks it back
My teeth snap shut with a crisp sound
I bite again and again
It tries to run, I bite its tail
I hold it down in the mud

lines.zh: 我从英国的地层里醒来
lines.en: I wake from the English strata
My nose horn emerges first
A Jurassic carnivore has arrived

lines.zh: 我的家族只有我一个属
lines.en: My family has only my genus

lines.zh: 四十点生命，够我在林中立足
lines.en: Forty health is enough to hold my ground here
Dust slides off my back

lines.zh: 我站直了，比你想象的快
lines.en: I straighten up, faster than you think

lines.zh: 这个世界的树比我见过的密
lines.en: The trees here are denser than any I knew
I give my tail a light shake

lines.zh: 我抬头，第一次看见这片林
lines.en: I lift my head and see this wood for the first time
My shadow falls across the damp wood
I plant my first step firmly

lines.zh: 我的鳞被火燎得卷起来
lines.en: The fire curled my scales

lines.zh: 落地时我的膝盖先着地
lines.en: My knees hit first when I landed
Water rushed in behind my nose horn
The blast threw me onto my side
A pellet lodged in my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股咒力烧着我的骨头
lines.en: That magic burned along my bones
I am so hungry I would bite bark
Lightning ran down my nose horn
There is no ground left for my feet
